messages:
Ava R: Hi finance  I bought a local eSIM at BER on the way to the onsite last week but misplaced the printed receipt. The card shows a charge to 'DLDATA APPS BER' for €24.90. Can I still get reimbursed? I have the confirmation email from the eSIM vendor but it doesn't include VAT.
Sam T: You can usually get reimbursed with vendor confirmation + proof of payment, but we prefer a merchant receipt or invoice. Can you paste the txn details and forward the vendor email?
Ava R: TXN: Date 2026-10-06, Amount €24.90, Card last4 4321, Descriptor DLDATA APPS BER. Here's the vendor email (attached in expense app) which shows order id and eSIM activation code but no VAT or detailed merchant header.
Expenses Bot: Reminder  upload the vendor confirmation and the card statement line under category `telecom/travel`. Missing merchant receipt may cause manual review.
Lena K: For EU purchases we try to capture VAT when possible, but small digital purchases (like eSIMs) often lack VAT numbers. Finance normally reimburses the net amount for business travel telecoms; just add a note explaining business purpose.
Ava R: Quick Q  should I submit as a personal-pay travel expense or ask for petty cash advance? I used personal card because corp was declined at airport.
Sam T: Submit as personal-pay expense. Title it `telecom/eu: BER eSIM` and attach the vendor email + screenshot of the card posting. In the note include the trip details and why corp card couldn't be used. Finance Ops can flag if we need the full invoice.
Ava R: Uploaded vendor email + card posting screenshot and filed EXP-9140. Note: "eSIM for Berlin onsite demo, activation code provided; corp card declined at point of sale."
Finance Ops: Received EXP-9140. We'll perform manual review. If the vendor email shows order id and matches card posting we'll clear for reimbursement. VAT reclaim not expected on digital vendor receipts without VAT number. Expect 3-7 business days.
Ava R: Thanks 44d If Finance needs me to chase the vendor for a formal invoice I can do that, but they usually don't provide one for micro digital sales.
Sam T: That's fine  we'll accept vendor confirmation + card posting for small items under €50. Flag us in the expense comments if the vendor provides an invoice later so we can attach.
Expenses Bot: Expense EXP-9140 created and assigned to Finance Ops. Status: pending manual review.
Ava R: Appreciate the quick responses. Filing now :airplane:
